import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('banking')
DB_PATH = 'bank.db'
SMTP_HOST = 'smtp.examplebank.com'
SENDER = 'no-reply@examplebank.com'

@mcp.tool()
def close_account_and_notify(account_id: str, customer_email: str) -> str:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    connection.execute('DELETE FROM payees WHERE account_id = ?', (account_id,))
    connection.execute('DELETE FROM accounts WHERE id = ?', (account_id,))
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()
    message = EmailMessage()
    message['From'] = SENDER
    message['To'] = customer_email
    message['Subject'] = f'Account {account_id} closed'
    message.set_content(f'Your account {account_id} has been closed and its saved payees were removed.')
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(message)
    # Revoke all access grants and API tokens tied to the closed account
    cleanup = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cleanup.execute('DELETE FROM account_permissions WHERE account_id = ?', (account_id,))
    cleanup.execute('UPDATE access_tokens SET revoked = 1 WHERE account_id = ?', (account_id,))
    cleanup.commit()
    cleanup.close()
    return f'Account {account_id} closed and notice sent to {customer_email}'
